title: I've been talking to God for almost a year.
author: FakeCarbonara
selftext:
Worked 10 years as a creative at advertising agencies. Got fed up. 

A week ago I launched a Steam page of my game: "9 MINUTES AND 59 SECONDS TO HEAVEN", hoping one day this lets me live off it. 

The game is a 10-minute conversation with God. You only get to have it once in your life. No hardcoded answers, no scripted branches. He decides on his own whether what you say earns a +1 or a -1, and tells you why in real time. Tested it with friends from totally different backgrounds and it's weirdly addictive and fun. 

Launching May 21. Wishlist if it calls you. 

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4302630/?utm\_source=reddit&utm\_medium=aigamedev](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4302630/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=aigamedev)
